dsh-AIR 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。DSH Web 输入框增强：跨会话召回已发送提示词、用 Ctrl+R 搜索并还原富草稿，以及提供停靠式 /btw 或 /side 旁路会话。

posts.en:
dsh-AIR is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Web composer enhancement: recalls sent prompts across sessions with ArrowUp/ArrowDown, searches them with Ctrl+R, restores rich drafts, and opens a docked /btw or /side conversation.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-7f4c53596e3375d171cd.html
